calibration: This shard confirms that the audit's single-word candidates are mostly generic prose matches. Accept links when a phrase names a defining ingredient or a named mathematical object whose target is read and convention-compatible; reject ordinary words, notation, and concepts already supplied by the source's own definition. Core links should expose prerequisites needed to parse the displayed definition, while supporting links can remain selective. No independently reusable missing definition was found in these eight sources.
